description: Address 5 review issues: MJPEG generator cleanup, resolution-dependent classification fix, rename severity to confidence, documentation drift, and MJPEG feed reconnection logic.
steps: In app.py, wrap _mjpeg_generator() with try/except GeneratorExit (or try/finally) so it cleans up gracefully when a client disconnects.

In inference_core.py, change _classify_crack() to normalize by frame area instead of using absolute pixel thresholds. Pass (h, w) to the function and use area_ratio = area_px / (h * w). Use ratio-based thresholds: < 0.002 = Hairline, < 0.01 = Surface-Level, else Structural. Update the call site in annotate_frame() to pass h, w.
Rename the severity field to confidence throughout: inference_core.py dict key, dashboard.js display labels and variable references, templates/dashboard.html if applicable.
In README.md and DEPLOY.md, replace all references to DROIDCAM_URL with IP_CAMERA_URL, and DroidCam with IP Camera.
In static/js/dashboard.js, add MJPEG feed reconnection logic: when pollStatus detects the connection recovered (camera_connected goes from false to true), reset the video feed img src.
acceptance_criteria: _mjpeg_generator() has a try/except GeneratorExit or try/finally block
_classify_crack() accepts h, w parameters and uses area_ratio normalization
No 'severity' key remains in inference_core.py metadata dict - replaced with 'confidence'
dashboard.js displays 'Confidence' instead of 'Severity' and references crack.confidence
README.md and DEPLOY.md have no references to DROIDCAM_URL or DroidCam
dashboard.js includes MJPEG reconnection logic triggered by camera_connected state change
findings: All 5 review fixes implemented and verified. _classify_crack now normalizes by frame area ratio. Confidence field replaces severity throughout backend and frontend. MJPEG generator has GeneratorExit cleanup. Dashboard reconnects MJPEG stream on camera recovery. No DroidCam or severity references remain.
